title: Jesus... He Cheated And Still Got The Higher Marks
topic: angry that a classmate who cheated got better marks

bible.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him; do not fret when people succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... he copied in the exam and still got higher marks than me. I studied every night. 😠

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I didn't cheat because of You. And now I'm the one who looks stupid.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're angry because it's unfair. It is unfair. I saw every night you studied.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does doing the right thing feel like losing?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because marks only count one paper. I count who you are becoming. He won a number. You kept yourself.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It still hurts when the results go up on the board.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: It will, for a while. But one day you'll stand somewhere you couldn't have reached by copying.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Keep your hands clean. Let Me handle the scoreboard.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever lost because you did the right thing? 💬
